qualification_scope: M1 original profile plus 95 cases; additional original-profile validation is reported per entrypoint; GEMM performance has separately scoped evidence
compiler_mode: C++ host-library calls plus HIP gfx1201 kernels compiled against a project-local overlay; Fortran ISO_C_BINDING to HIP separately qualified
historical_device_note: HIP ordinal0 maps to excluded physical GPU3; early original-port diagnostics on ordinal0 are excluded from final qualification. Historical M1 ordinal1 maps physical GPU2; later runs use guard-checked physical0/1.
device_policy: Physical GPU3 excluded. Reservation and PCI mapping checked dynamically per run; earlier physical2 runs preceded its later reservation. Contended cards may validate correctness but fail performance idle gate.
